name: verify-library
title: Re-check ownership across the whole library
summary: Confirm every library entry is still owned, as a periodic check or before downloading everything

steps.why: Walk the library for its UIDs, then ask Fab for each one's state, 24 at a time
steps.check: meta.total and results[] with owned:false (should be none)

notes: The library walk takes about 100 s per 1,000 assets. Set FABCLI_LIBRARY_CACHE=1 so later library reads come from disk.
Don't start other library-reading commands in parallel while the cache is cold.
